info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Account Management Counterparty Risk-spec
info.description: This API enables businesses to establish and manage counterparty risk profiles within their account management systems. By integrating this API, organizations can automate the assessment and registration of counterparties, ensuring compliance with risk management protocols. Typical users include financial institutions and risk assessment teams that require efficient handling of counterparty risk data. The API supports operations critical for maintaining a secure and compliant banking environment.

post.summary: Create a new counterparty risk record.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new counterparty risk record in the account management system. By providing the necessary details, users can effectively manage and assess the risks associated with each counterparty.

requestBody.description: Request payload for creating or updating counterparty risk information. This body should contain the necessary details to assess and manage the counterparty risk associated with a specific account.

201.description: Resource successfully created for the counterparty risk.
